# Copyright and licenses — c2pkg

Handwritten files of this module are published under a dual license,
Apache-2.0 or MIT. The Apache-2.0 text is `LICENSE`. The MIT text is
`LICENSE-MIT` (Copyright (c) 2026 Lateos). The wal-g preamble of that
MIT file does not apply here: this module contains no wal-g material.

Transpiled files keep the licence of their C source. House C under
`/devhoros/c2simd/sources/` has no third-party banner and follows the
module dual license. The one third-party emit (Poly1305 from Monocypher
4.0.2) keeps the upstream banner copied into `LICENSE-MONOCYPHER`.

## File classes

| File class | Origin | License |
|---|---|---|
| `*_gen.go` whose first line is `// Code generated by sgoiter` (except `c2poly1305`) | Mechanical transpile from house C under `/devhoros/c2simd/sources/` (no third-party banner). Headers carry `sgoiter-stamp` and do not name `sgoiter -in` | Apache-2.0 / MIT |
| `c2poly1305/poly1305_gen.go` | Mechanical transpile of Poly1305 from `monocypher.c` 4.0.2 (Loup Vaillant). Oracle `sources/test_poly1305_oracle.c` compiles `/devhoros/c2simd/spec/c_sources/upstream/monocypher/4.0.2/monocypher.c`. Upstream licence copied from that file lines 1–52 into `LICENSE-MONOCYPHER` | CC0 1.0 or BSD-2-Clause, recipient's choice |
| `c2archsimd/c2archsimd_nosimd_gen.go` | Handwritten fallback (`//go:build` only ; no `Code generated` stamp) | Apache-2.0 / MIT |
| Handwritten `*.go` and tests in every `c2*` package | This project | Apache-2.0 / MIT |
| `c2tuidiff/diff_simd_amd64.go`, `diff_simd_arm64.go` | Handwritten SIMD paths around the sgoiter emit | Apache-2.0 / MIT |

## Fork-authored code

`LICENSE-MIT` applies to the following Lateos-authored files, in
addition to `LICENSE`:

- every handwritten `.go` file under `c2alias`, `c2archsimd`, `c2base64`,
  `c2blueteam`, `c2chacha1`, `c2chacha8`, `c2dxgi`, `c2grid`, `c2myers`,
  `c2oracle`, `c2pngfilter`, `c2poly1305` (tests only), `c2pty`, `c2q55`,
  `c2quic`, `c2ssim`, `c2swizzle`, `c2tui`, `c2tuidiff` (including SIMD
  paths), `c2uuidv7`, `c2vtparser`
- `c2archsimd/c2archsimd_nosimd_gen.go`

`c2poly1305/poly1305_gen.go` and every other `*_gen.go` that carries
`// Code generated by sgoiter` are excluded from this list.
